content.text:
Every request and the drop box now work on the caller's own library system only. The existing test suite passes (46 tests). I added no new tests, so a record from another system returning 404 is untested.

- **`src/api.mjs`:** these lookups now go through the caller's own system, so another system's record returns the same 404 as an unknown id:
  - `GET /titles` lists only the caller's titles.
  - `GET /copies/:id` and `GET /loans/:id` only find the caller's own copies and loans.
  - `POST /loans` looks up the copy in the caller's system. Lending another system's copy returns 404 `no-copy`.
  - `POST /holds` looks up the title in the caller's system. Holding another system's title returns 404 `no-title`.
- **`src/dropbox.mjs`:** a scan only finds copies in the message's own system. A scan of another system's copy is acknowledged with `unknown-copy` and changes nothing.

Some cases were already scoped and I left them alone. These were members, notices, holds, `POST /copies` against another system's title, and checking in or renewing a loan.

The drop box's "already seen" check is still by message id alone, across all systems. A message from one system that reuses an id another system already delivered would be acknowledged as `duplicate`. I assumed message ids are unique and left that as is.

EVAL_STATUS: DONE
